Successfully led and supported multiple banking and payments projects across Cards, SWIFT, Reconciliation, Merchant Onboarding, and Payment Systems. • Contributed to payment message transformation initiatives and supported ISO 20022 readiness activities. • Managed multiple stakeholders and parallel workstreams in fast-paced delivery environments. • Delivered projects on time through effective planning, stakeholder communication, issue resolution, and team coordination. • Mentored junior team members and supported business and technical teams in understanding payment message standards and process flows.
